exampleEnglish: I need to make a decision today.
note: En inglés se dice MAKE a decision, no 'take' ni 'do'.

exampleEnglish: Let's take a break for ten minutes.
exampleSpanish: Tomemos un descanso de diez minutos.
note: También 'take a rest', pero 'take a break' es lo más común en EE. UU.

exampleEnglish: I have breakfast at seven.
note: HAVE breakfast / lunch / dinner. Sin artículo: 'have breakfast', no 'have a breakfast'.

exampleEnglish: She does her homework after school.
exampleSpanish: Ella hace su tarea después de la escuela.
note: DO homework. 'homework' es incontable: no 'homeworks'.

exampleEnglish: Please pay attention to the teacher.
exampleSpanish: Por favor presta atención al maestro.
note: PAY attention TO something/someone.

exampleEnglish: Can you take a photo of us?
note: TAKE a photo / a picture. También 'take a selfie'.

exampleEnglish: Everyone can make a mistake.
note: MAKE a mistake, no 'do a mistake' ni 'commit a mistake'.

exampleEnglish: Have fun at the party!
note: HAVE fun. 'fun' aquí es sustantivo incontable.

exampleEnglish: I take a shower every morning.
note: TAKE a shower (EE. UU.). En británico también 'have a shower'.

exampleEnglish: It's your turn to do the dishes.
note: DO the dishes / do the laundry / do the cleaning.

exampleEnglish: It's easy to make friends here.
note: MAKE friends (with someone).

exampleEnglish: Don't go out or you'll catch a cold.
exampleSpanish: No salgas o te vas a resfriar.
note: CATCH a cold. 'Estar resfriado' = 'have a cold'.

exampleEnglish: Don't waste time on your phone.
exampleSpanish: No pierdas el tiempo en el teléfono.
note: WASTE time / money. Opuesto: 'save time'.

exampleEnglish: I want to save money this year.
note: SAVE money / time / energy.

exampleEnglish: You should always tell the truth.
note: TELL the truth / a lie / a story / a joke.

exampleEnglish: Can you keep a secret?
note: KEEP a secret / a promise / a diary.

exampleEnglish: Please make an effort to be on time.
exampleSpanish: Por favor haz un esfuerzo por llegar a tiempo.
note: MAKE an effort (to do something).

exampleEnglish: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
note: TAKE a risk / a chance.

exampleEnglish: They get married next month.
note: GET married (TO someone). 'married WITH' es un error típico.

exampleEnglish: I take notes during every class.
note: TAKE notes.

exampleEnglish: Sorry, I'm running late.
note: Muy usado en EE. UU. 'I'm running late' = voy tarde.

exampleEnglish: That doesn't make sense to me.
note: MAKE sense. 'It makes sense' = tiene lógica.

exampleEnglish: Take care and see you soon.
note: 'Take care!' se usa como despedida. 'Take care OF' = cuidar de algo/alguien.

exampleEnglish: We had a good time at the beach.
exampleSpanish: La pasamos bien en la playa.
note: HAVE a good time. Sinónimo de 'have fun'.
